name: Barbell Bench Press
cue: Tuck elbows to 45 degrees and drive feet into the floor.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Touch the bar high on the chest, just below the collarbone.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue: Lower under control until dumbbells reach chest level.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cue: Keep shoulder blades pinned back throughout the press.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cue: Pause briefly when triceps touch the floor, then press.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cue: Squeeze glutes and push your head through at lockout.

name: Standing Dumbbell Overhead Press
cue: Brace your core so your ribs stay down, not flared.

name: Arnold Press
cue: Rotate palms from facing you to facing forward as you press.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
cue: Keep the wrist straight and the bell resting on the forearm.

name: Push-Up
cue: Keep a straight line from head to heels the whole rep.

name: Diamond Push-Up
cue: Form a diamond with thumbs and index fingers under your chest.

name: Decline Push-Up
cue: Elevate feet on a chair or bench and keep hips level.

name: Archer Push-Up
cue: Shift your weight over the bending arm; keep the other arm straight.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
cue: Turn fingers back and lean shoulders far past your hands.

name: Pike Push-Up
cue: Hips high, lower the crown of your head toward the floor.

name: Dip
cue: Lean slightly forward and lower until upper arms are parallel.

name: Bench Dip
cue: Keep hips close to the bench and elbows pointing straight back.

name: Machine Chest Press
cue: Set handles at mid-chest height and press without locking elbows hard.

name: Cable Fly
cue: Keep a slight elbow bend and hug the cables together like a barrel.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
cue: Lower with a fixed elbow angle until you feel a chest stretch.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cue: Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cue: Stand side-on to the stack and raise the arm in a wide arc.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cue: Raise to eye level without swinging your torso.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Keep elbows close to your ears and stretch deep behind the head.

name: Triceps Pushdown
cue: Pin elbows to your sides and fully straighten the arms.

name: Skull Crusher
cue: Lower the bar to your forehead with elbows fixed in place.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cue: Grip just inside shoulder width and keep elbows tucked.

name: Pull-Up
cue: Pull your chest to the bar, not just your chin.

name: Chin-Up
cue: Underhand grip; drive elbows down toward your ribs.

name: Negative Pull-Up
cue: Jump to the top and lower yourself over a slow 3-5 seconds.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
cue: Add load only once you own 10 strict bodyweight reps.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
cue: Wide overhand grip; think of pulling your elbows into your pockets.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
cue: Arms stay straight; lift only by pulling shoulder blades down.

name: Dead Hang
cue: Relax into the hang and breathe; grip is the only thing working.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cue: Hinge to about 45 degrees and pull the bar to your lower ribs.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue: Row to your hip, not your armpit, without twisting the torso.

name: Inverted Row
cue: Body straight as a plank; pull your chest to the bar or table edge.

name: Seated Cable Row
cue: Sit tall and pull the handle to your stomach without leaning back.

name: Lat Pulldown
cue: Pull the bar to your upper chest with elbows driving down.

name: Face Pull
cue: Pull the rope to your face and finish with thumbs pointing back.

name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
cue: Keep your chest glued to the pad so only the back works.

name: Renegade Row
cue: In plank on dumbbells, row without letting hips rotate.

name: Kettlebell Row
cue: Hinge with a flat back and row the bell to your hip.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cue: Snap the hips forward; the arms are just ropes.

name: Barbell Curl
cue: Pin elbows to your sides and curl without swinging the hips.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cue: Fully straighten the arm at the bottom of every rep.

name: Hammer Curl
cue: Neutral grip, palms facing each other the entire rep.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cue: Let arms hang behind your torso for a long biceps stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
cue: Brace your elbow on the inner thigh and curl slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears; no rolling.

name: Bent-Over Reverse Fly
cue: Hinge over and open your arms wide like spreading wings.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cue: Arms nearly straight; sweep the bar down to your thighs.

name: Barbell Back Squat
cue: Break at hips and knees together; keep your chest proud.

name: Barbell Front Squat
cue: Elbows high so the bar rests on your shoulders, torso upright.

name: Goblet Squat
cue: Hold the weight at your chest and sit down between your heels.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cue: Full depth with heels down and knees tracking over toes.

name: Jump Squat
cue: Land soft and quiet, absorbing into the next rep.

name: Conventional Deadlift
cue: Take the slack out of the bar and push the floor away.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cue: Push hips back with soft knees until hamstrings stretch hard.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cue: Slide the dumbbells down the front of your legs, back flat.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cue: Square hips to the floor as the back leg reaches behind you.

name: Walking Lunge
cue: Long steps, back knee kissing the floor each rep.

name: Reverse Lunge
cue: Step back and drop straight down, front shin vertical.

name: Lateral Lunge
cue: Sit into one hip while the other leg stays straight.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cue: Rear foot on a bench or chair; drop the back knee straight down.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cue: Tuck your chin and squeeze glutes hard at full extension.

name: Glute Bridge
cue: Drive through the heels and pause one second at the top.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cue: Keep hips level; don't let the free side sag.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cue: Drive through the top foot; don't push off the bottom leg.

name: Box Pistol Squat
cue: Lower on one leg to a bench or chair, tap, and stand back up.

name: Pistol Squat
cue: Reach arms and free leg forward to counterbalance.

name: Standing Calf Raise
cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the very top.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cue: Work from a step edge for a full range of motion.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cue: Slow tempo; the bent knee targets the deeper soleus.

name: Leg Press
cue: Lower until knees near your chest without your hips curling up.

name: Leg Extension
cue: Squeeze the quads for a beat at full lockout.

name: Lying Leg Curl
cue: Keep hips pressed into the pad as you curl.

name: Wall Sit
cue: Thighs parallel to the floor, back flat against the wall.

name: Plank
cue: Squeeze glutes and tuck the pelvis; no sagging hips.

name: Side Plank
cue: Stack your feet and push the hip toward the ceiling.

name: Hollow Body Hold
cue: Press your lower back into the floor the entire hold.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
cue: Curl knees to your chest without swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cue: Straight legs to hip height or above; tilt the pelvis up at the top.

name: Barbell Rollout
cue: Roll out only as far as you can without your lower back arching.

name: Plank Walkout
cue: Walk your hands out past plank position, keeping ribs down.

name: Russian Twist
cue: Rotate from the torso; your eyes follow your hands.

name: Dead Bug
cue: Extend opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays glued down.

name: Bird Dog
cue: Reach long and hold each rep for two seconds without wobbling.

name: Bicycle Crunch
cue: Slow rotation, elbow toward the opposite knee each rep.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cue: Lower legs slowly without letting the lower back lift.

name: V-Up
cue: Fold at the hips, touching hands to feet at the top.

name: Cable Woodchopper
cue: Rotate through the hips and torso with arms staying long.

name: Cable Crunch
cue: Kneel and crunch your ribs toward your hips, not your arms down.

name: Shadowboxing Round
cue: Stay on the balls of your feet; every punch returns to guard.

name: Jump Rope
cue: Small hops from the ankles, wrists doing the spinning.

name: Burpee
cue: Chest to floor, then jump with full hip extension.

name: Mountain Climber
cue: Hips stay low and level while the knees drive fast.

name: High Knees
cue: Drive knees to hip height with a fast arm swing.

name: Sprint Intervals
cue: Sprint hard, then walk back for full recovery between reps.

name: Hill Sprints
cue: Lean into the hill and drive your knees with short, punchy strides.

name: Easy Run
cue: Conversational pace; you should be able to talk in full sentences.

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
cue: Clean the bell softly to the rack, then press with a tight core.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
cue: Punch your hand through at the top so the bell lands softly.

name: Kettlebell Complex (Swing-Clean-Press)
cue: One round = 5 swings, 5 cleans, 5 presses per arm without setting the bell down.

name: Bear Crawl
cue: Knees hover an inch off the floor; move opposite hand and foot.

name: Jumping Jacks
cue: Light on your feet with a full arm swing overhead.

name: Skater Jump
cue: Bound side to side and stick each landing on one leg.

name: Devil's Press
cue: Burpee over the dumbbells, then swing them overhead in one motion.

name: Farmer's Carry
cue: Walk tall with shoulders back; don't let the weights pull you sideways.

name: Pec Deck Fly
cue: Elbows slightly bent; squeeze the pads together, don’t slam.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue: Press without locking out; keep your lower back on the pad.

name: Cable Crossover
cue: Slight forward lean; hug a barrel and squeeze at the midline.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
cue: Elbows by the ears; only the forearms move.

name: Machine Reverse Fly
cue: Lead with the elbows; pause when arms line up with shoulders.

name: Machine Pullover
cue: Drive the elbows down in a wide arc; feel the lats stretch.

name: Machine High Row
cue: Pull down and back toward the hips; chest stays on the pad.

name: Cable Curl
cue: Pin elbows to your sides; control the lowering.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
cue: Full stretch at the bottom; no shoulder swing.

name: Hack Squat
cue: Feet mid-platform; ride the rails down until thighs hit parallel.

name: Seated Leg Curl
cue: Squeeze at full bend and resist on the way back.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cue: Hinge at the hips and snap forward with the glutes.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
cue: Push the knees out slowly; pause at the widest point.

name: Cable Standing Calf Raise
cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

name: Cable Seated Twist
cue: Rotate from the ribs; hips stay square.

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
cue: Curl the pelvis up; knees to chest, no leg swing.

name: Stationary Bike
cue: Keep cadence high; steady breathing.

name: Elliptical
cue: Push and pull the handles; full-body rhythm.

name: Ski Erg
cue: Hinge and drive down with lats and abs on every pull.
